chunks: And from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
A believer is a brother to another believer, and it is his right that he should counsel him, sympathize with him, and prevent his enemies from harming him.
ai.seo_question: What are the rights of a believer upon another believer in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) defines the believer's bond through three active duties: offering sincere counsel (nasihah), providing support (mawasat), and shielding the brother from external adversaries. This triad reflects the Shia concept of *wilayah* extending to interpersonal relations, transforming spiritual brotherhood into tangible social protection and mutual aid within the community.

en.muhajir-b-ali: 96. It has been reported that Abu 'Abd Allah (a.s) said:
A believer is a brother to another believer and it is his right that he should counsel him, sympathize with him and prevent his enemies from harming him.
